item.title: Elon Musk’s proposed Tesla tunnel loop met with opposition by Nashville metro council
item.description: Nashville officials have raised concerns about safety, insufficient transparency and efforts to sidestep local input.

item.title: US issues first commercial construction permit for a nuclear reactor in years to a Wyoming project
item.description: TerraPower filed for the permit in 2024 and construction is set to begin within weeks.

item.title: US Homeland Security investigates whether Bovino made disparaging comments about Jewish faith
item.description: The investigation comes after reports on remarks Gregory Bovino allegedly made during a phone call.

item.title: Protester, three Capitol Police officers treated for injuries after scuffle in Senate hearing room
item.description: A man protesting the war in Iran has been arrested after a struggle.

item.title: Whether primary ballots set aside in two Texas counties will be counted remains uncertain
item.description: Democrats in deeply blue Dallas County say their hopes are dwindling

item.title: Trump’s White House ballroom is too big, architect says, as 2nd panel prepares to vote on it
item.description: A federal commission meets Thursday to consider the 90,000-square-foot project and to vote on whether to approve it.

item.title: Free AARP tax-aide service offered at Estes Valley Library
item.description: Since 2005, the Estes Valley Library has hosted AARP Tax-Aide volunteers to provide free federal and state income tax filing assistance for Estes Valley residents. Tax-Aide appointments are available now through April 14.

item.title: Last 2 names of 6 US soldiers who died in Kuwait attack identified by the Pentagon
item.description: Four soldiers were previously identified by the Pentagon on Tuesday.

item.title: Estes Park law enforcement arrests for Feb. 16-March 1, 2026
item.description: A 49-year-old man was arrested Feb. 20 in the 1100 block of Fairway Club Circle for obstructing government operations.

item.title: Estes Park code enforcement officer will discuss dogs at Coffee and Tea at PD
item.description: The Estes Park Police Department will host its regular Coffee & Tea at the PD from 9 to 10 a.m. Thursday in the lobby of Town Hall, at 170 MacGregor Ave.
